items.text: New York Jets: WR Garrett Wilson in concussion protocol (DNP); DNP - LB Demario Davis, DT Harrison Phillips; limited - RB Breece Hall (quad, could return), DE David Bailey (groin), DE Joseph Ossai (ankle), TE Mason Taylor. DT T'Vondre Sweat (IR), WR Arian Smith (ACL) out.

Kansas City: DT Peter Woods (neck) DNP; limited - TE Travis Kelce (ankle), WR Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee), CB Mansoor Delane, DT Omarr Norman-Lott. QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) full. On IR: CB L'Jarius Sneed, OT Josh Simmons.
items.source: A to Z Sports, Chiefs Thursday injury report
